svg.title: A PlanRequest on the time line
svg.desc: Animated: what each PlanRequest field means relative to the schedule Dispatch is already running: base_state is the garage now, base_schedule the actions that keep running during the call, and the three job lists sort jobs by how much of them that schedule covers.
svg.metadata: ["The schedule Dispatch is running when it calls Plan(). Each box is one ActionNode on the lane of the asset that executes it. Faded boxes are finished. The line marks now, when the request is built.", "id is a fresh Guid that the response echoes. base_state is the garage at now, as a discrete snapshot: AGV-2 has lifted T15 at P15 (a0 is finished) and waits for a1.", "The split. Actions before it keep being sent while the call is in flight: they form base_schedule (a1, a2, b1), which the scheduler must assume will complete. Actions after it are held back (outside_split = true) and are not sent.", "planned_jobs: jobs that base_schedule finishes (J-B, the bay transition). active_jobs: jobs with actions in base_schedule that it does not finish (J-A: its lower, a3, is held back).", "pending_jobs: jobs to plan now (j0 and j1). They have no actions yet. Plan() reads only id, base_state, base_schedule and pending_jobs; planned_jobs and active_jobs are not read.", "Plan() reserves AGV-2 and B21 from now to the end of the new plan, plans j1 on AGV-1 and fails j0 (it needs AGV-2). The response holds only the new actions; joining them to the running schedule is Dispatch's job."]

g.text: A PlanRequest on the time line

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The request describes one moment in a schedule that keeps running. Lane colours: violet = assets busy in base_schedule. Durations and the place of the split are illustrative; where Dispatch draws the split is not in the snapshots.
